Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any other client that supports stdio-transport MCP servers.
servers.name: Env Validator

servers.description: Aggregates revenue across Lemon Squeezy + Gumroad + Polar + Stripe into a single Claude-queryable view. Six tools: summary_mrr, top_customers, refund_signal, recent_orders, export_csv_for_tax (Ukrainian FOP format), health. Lemon Squeezy adapter live-validated against production.

LS_STORE_ID.description: Optional store ID filter to limit the scope to a specific store

LS_API_TOKEN.description: Your Lemon Squeezy API token. Get one from https://app.lemonsqueezy.com/settings/api

servers.name: Indie Founder Revenue MCP

servers.description: Remote MCP server for EVE Online that validates ship fittings with actual stats, DPS/EHP, and live market prices, enabling LLMs to answer whether a fit works and what it costs.
servers.name: jita-mcp

servers.description: Enables agents to manage and organize local documents by listing, inspecting, extracting text, searching, and renaming files, with optional Google Drive integration.

HOST.description: Host to bind the server to.

DOC_ROOT.description: Path to the document root folder the agent is allowed to inspect.

DOC_EXTENSIONS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional OAuth access token for Google Drive integration.

servers.name: Document Organizer MCP

servers.description: Local-first MCP server for agents that need to work across multiple Gmail and Microsoft 365 accounts without cloud token storage.

MAILMCP_MASTER_KEY.description: The vault key derived from this environment variable if set, otherwise generated locally.

servers.name: multi-mail-mcp

servers.description: Enables integration with QR Agent Studio via MCP Streamable HTTP and Agent Skills, forwarding authenticated requests to manage QR records.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: The public base URL of this MCP gateway.

QRCODING_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the QR Agent Studio deployment to forward requests to. If unset, defaults to the current qrcoding preview deployment used during setup.
